newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt hotelier 95/96 profits up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt hotelier 95/96 profits up 18 pct.

text.p: Misr Hotels net distributable profits rose 17.7 percent in financial 1995/96 to 24.59 million pounds ($7.23 million) from 20.90 million in the previous year, results published on Saturday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.

The results said the state-dominated firm, which owns Hilton and other hotels in Egypt, would give shareholders 7,500 pounds of that profit. The firm has about 3,000 shares and the profit would mean a 2.5 pound dividend for each share.
In financial 94/95, the firm also distributed a 2.5 pound dividend.
Unaudited results made available earlier this year said net profits had risen 39 percent in 1995/96 financial year to 29 million pounds ($8.5 million) from 20.8 million pounds in the previous year.
